title: K5 S Gloss White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the AGV K5 S Gloss White is engineered for everyday agility, rapid ventilation, and effortless usability. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at 1392g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~87 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Mid-range sport-touring with internal sun visor and wide field of view.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Medium-to-high profile fit; slightly roomy in the crown compared to K3/K4, requires specific cheek pads for a tight seal on wide faces.

technical_analysis: Features 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance paired with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view. The interior utilizes 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the AGV K5 S Gloss White: combining Italy 🇮🇹 craftsmanship with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view and 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Full Face lineup, the K5 S Gloss White brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The AGV K5 S Gloss White represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV K5 S Gloss White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
